text:
The summary is accurate on the points that matter. It gets the date, the 35° threshold, the 15% battery figure (limited to recent phones), the Monday email and the opt-out for heat warnings right. It also covers every section, and the thank-you and help-centre lines are rightly dropped. I count about 117 words, so it meets the limit, though only just.

Small weaknesses:
- It drops "some" from the New Zealand time zone fix, so it reads as if all NZ users were affected.
- It drops "sometimes" from the paused-workout fix, which slightly overstates how often that bug occurred.
- It omits where to turn off heat warnings (Settings > Safety), a minor detail.
- "Screen reader labels on the workout screen" loses the "all buttons" detail.
- It lists every minor item rather than prioritising for a busy manager, though the formatting is easy to scan.

These are minor imprecisions rather than errors.

Score: 8
